name: Monica
desc: One-stop assistant bundling many models in a browser
desc_zh: 把多家大模型收进一个浏览器助手
solves: Lets you answer one question across several models and compare, without five tabs open.
solves_zh: 同一个问题可以换几个模型对比，不用开五个标签页。
best_for: You have a subscription to one model but need a second opinion from another.
best_for_zh: 只订了某家模型，还想找另一家给个对照时。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：AICPB AI产品榜 出海总榜 App, 649.56K MAU。来源：https://monica.im/
